full_judgment: 28. Significantly further, the Annexure- 'D' IGM generated through the ASYCUDA World System attests to this Court's satisfaction the fact that the concerned vessel MV Heilan Brother arrived on 12-6-2019 at 3-53 pm and that the said IGM clearly bears UUI No. 2019 in satisfaction of the requirements of section 79 of the Act as well as IGM No. 2104. As earlier noted, the Respondent No. 2, Commissioner has speciously submitted that absent a countersignature by the relevant Customs Authority the IGM as transmitted is of no legal consequence. But in accepting Mr Kamal-ul Alam's rebuttal as already above noted, this Court finds to the contrary that section 46 understandably and necessarily does away with the requirement of an actual counter-signature in favour of a presumption of such a countersignature when the import manifest is transmitted electronically as in this case to the concerned Customs Officer through the Customs computer system ASYCUDA by a registered user such as the Petitioner using his UUI No. 2019.
